row: Starting your own business in the height of a global pandemic is a scary move. Something that most people would have shied away from, and yet, here we are! The Cameron Veterinary Services is expanding and has been thriving since opening its doors as a mobile veterinary clinic in 2020. The aim of the practice is to provide high quality, personalised veterinary care, and spread as much information about veterinary medicine as possible. To that end, we have created this channel to help do exactly that, and perhaps shine the light on some of the aspects of a mobile veterinary clinic.
